name: Unstructured Partition Strategies
mechanism: Partitions many document types with selectable fast, high-resolution, OCR-only or automatic strategies and optional table-structure extraction.
use_when: One integration must partition many common file types
Per-document routing between fast and layout-aware paths is useful
avoid_when: Highest-fidelity complex tables are mandatory without corpus evaluation
Strictly deterministic output is required across dependency updates
expected_effects: Bounded escalation to OCR and high-resolution layout
failure_modes: Auto strategy selects a weak path
Table extraction depends on strategy and model
required_evals: latency and failure rate by format
